description: A finite clause set is unsatisfiable if and only if it has a resolution refutation.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.refutation_iff.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.ClauseSet α) :
  ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.Sat Γ ↔ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.Derives Γ ∅
